title: Live AI Signal in Mission Control — Real ChatGPT Streaming
goal: When ChatGPT OAuth is connected, stream real AI analysis into the Mission Control AI Signal panel after each task completes, instead of showing deterministic template text.
scope: Add a streaming AI analysis endpoint and wire it to the Mission Control AI Signal panel. After each task reaches status=completed, the backend calls ChatGPT with: task tool name, task target, top 3 findings from the task, current inventory summary, and asks for a 3-sentence security analysis (what was found, what it means, what to do next). Stream the response token-by-token via GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/ai-signal/stream (SSE endpoint). In Mission Control, after a task completes the AI Signal panel shows a typing cursor and streams the text. When complete, store the analysis as an AgentReasoning record. When ChatGPT is not configured, show current deterministic mission guidance as before. Add a provider status indicator in the AI Signal panel header showing ChatGPT icon + Connected or Deterministic mode label.
generation_reason: AI Signal panel shows static deterministic text. ChatGPT is connected but never actually called for real-time analysis. This is the primary reason the system does not feel alive.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: AI Signal streaming only. Do not auto-execute any tool suggestions from AI. Analysis is advisory only.

success_criteria: When ChatGPT configured, stream shows real ChatGPT response after task completion.
When ChatGPT not configured, shows deterministic text (no regression).
Streaming text appears in AI Signal panel with typing indicator.
Provider status badge visible in AI Signal header.

acceptance_criteria: AI Signal streams real ChatGPT response when provider configured. Deterministic fallback unchanged.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
